verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh ships its own AI agents (screening and transaction-monitoring agentic workflows), so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to or consume external MCP servers. The llms.txt file, OpenAPI schema and webhooks are adjacent features, not MCP-client support, and Starter Plan agent configurations are explicitly not customizable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
